directions:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create the first of two matching page-mascot sprite sheets using the attached robot as the identity reference. A 3x3 grid of NINE HEAD DIRECTIONS. Redraw as a cute BIG HEAD CHIBI robot, oversized rounded rectangular retro television head with a projecting circular white smiley faceplate, black recessed area behind plate, circular mechanical ears, one short ball-tipped antenna, exposed small mechanical neck and white hoodie. Preserve recognizable identity. Black and white pen-and-ink drawing, varied bold outlines, sparing fine hatching, crisp open white areas. Cute simplified cartoon, not realistic. No color. White surfaces must be opaque white, background genuinely transparent with real alpha.
LAYOUT: 3 columns by 3 rows evenly spaced in square PNG at least 1024x1024. Head and upper shoulders only; no arms hands lower body. Head width 1.5 times shoulders. Draw BODY ONCE and reuse exact same front-facing neck chest shoulders in exact same position all nine cells. Only whole head turns. Each bust centered at 75% cell height with wide empty margins ALL four sides, including above antenna and below shoulders. Nothing touches cell boundaries.
Same friendly oval-eyed curved smile in every cell. Whole head direction changes clearly. Row1: viewer's up-left, up, up-right. Row2: viewer's left, straight front, viewer's right. Row3: down-left, down, down-right. Left faces image left, right faces image right. No floating symbols, labels, grids, borders, shadows, text. Hoodie can be simplified without lettering. Output real transparent PNG.
reactions:
Create the MATCHING EXPRESSIONS 3x3 sprite sheet of the attached robot DIRECTIONS sheet. Same cute ink chibi robot: white rounded television head, black recess, large circular white smile faceplate, round mechanical ears, single ball antenna, small exposed mechanical neck, white hoodie. Copy ink art style, head scale and front-facing body from center cell exactly. Black and white only with clean bold linework and sparse hatching. All NINE heads straight at viewer. Identical neck shoulders and chest same width and position in every cell. Portrait bust only, shoulders narrower than head, no arms hands or lower body. Each drawing fully inside evenly spaced 3x3 cells with ample empty space on all sides including below shoulders and above antenna. Character occupies 75% cell height. 
Expressions left-right top-bottom: 1 eyes closed upward happy arcs, smile; 2 happy closed eyes and small outlined heart above head; 3 happy closed eyes and three small sparkle stars above head; 4 wide round surprised eyes and small O mouth; 5 star-shaped eyes big smile; 6 closed happy eyes with hatched blushing cheeks; 7 sleeping closed eyes plus small z z z above head; 8 spiral eyes wobbly mouth; 9 closed happy eyes big open grin. Symbols monochrome.
PNG WITH REAL RGBA ALPHA CHANNEL. Genuinely transparent empty background. NO painted checkerboard, NO black background, NO white backdrop. White robot surfaces opaque white. Crisp clean silhouette without stray pixels. No labels borders shadows.
